find_items.description: Find the items on a Monday.com board whose column holds a value, such as every item whose Status is Stuck or whose Email is ada@example.com, each with its group and its columns as text. A people column, such as Owner, is a name in columns; the email addresses of the people in it come back in each item's people (by the column's title) and owner_emails (the item's first people column), ready to send an email to.
find_items.display_str_template: Find items on board {0} whose column {1} is {2}.
find_items.name: find_items

parameters.description: The board to look on.
parameters.name: board_id

parameters.description: The column to look in, such as Status or Email.
parameters.name: column_id

parameters.description: What the column holds, in full: a status label such as Done, a person's name, a date such as 2026-11-30, or the whole text of a text column.
parameters.name: value

columns.description: The item's columns as text, by the column's title on the board.

group.description: The title of the group the item sits in.

owner_emails.description: Beta. The email addresses of the people in the item's first people column, whatever its title, as one text: "ada@acme.com", or "ada@acme.com, bob@acme.com" for several. Use it as an email step's To field, or group items by it to send each person their own list. Blank when nobody is assigned or the board has no people column. Teams are left out.

owner_names.description: Beta. The names in the item's first people column, as Monday.com shows them, such as "Ada Lovelace, Bob Stone". Blank when nobody is assigned or the board has no people column.

people.description: Beta. The email addresses of the people in each people column (such as Owner), by the column's title on the board, as one text: "ada@acme.com", or "ada@acme.com, bob@acme.com" for several, which an email step's To field takes as it is. Blank when nobody is assigned. A team in the column has no email address and is left out.

url.description: Beta. The link that opens the item in Monday.com.

list_board_items.description: List the items in a Monday.com board (up to 500), each with its group and its columns by title as text, such as Status, Owner and Due date. Beta: it can keep only past-due items and leave out items with a status such as Done, gives each item its owners' names and emails, and lists the items by owner, so emailing each person their items needs no filter, grouping or lookup step.
list_board_items.name: list_board_items

parameters.description: The board to list items from.
parameters.name: board_id

parameters.description: Beta. Only list items whose due date is before today (UTC), so a list of overdue work needs no filtering step. Items with no due date are left out. The due date is read from the column named in Due date column, or the board's first date column when that is blank. With this or Leave out status set, the whole board is read (up to 5,000 items), not only its first 500.
parameters.name: past_due_only

parameters.description: Beta. The title of the date column that holds each item's due date, such as Due date, as it shows on the board. Leave blank to use the board's first date column.
parameters.name: due_date_column

parameters.description: Beta. Leave out items whose status is this label, such as Done, in any case. Separate several labels with commas, such as Done, Cancelled. Leave blank to keep every status.
parameters.name: exclude_status

parameters.description: Beta. The title of the people column whose people own each item, such as Owner. Leave blank to use the board's first people column.
parameters.name: owner_column

by_owner.description: Beta. One entry per person in the owner column, with their name, email, their items and how many, so emailing each person their own items needs no grouping step. An item with two owners is in both people's lists; an item with no owner is in none.

count.description: How many of the items are theirs.

email.description: The person's email, or blank when Monday.com doesn't give it.

columns.description: The item's columns as text, by title.

days_overdue.description: Beta. How many days ago the due date passed; 0 when it hasn't.

due_date.description: Beta. The item's due date as YYYY-MM-DD, from the due date column, or blank when it has none.

url.description: Beta. The link that opens the item in monday.com, ready to put in an email or message.

description: Create and manage items on your Monday.com boards.

monday_column_value_changed_trigger.description: Runs each time someone changes a column on an item of a Monday.com board, such as its Status, Owner or Due date: any column, or only the one you choose. Changes made before the workflow is turned on don't start it.

output.board_id: The board the item is on.
output.column: The title of the column that changed, such as Status.
output.column_id: The ID of the column that changed.
output.emails: Beta. The item's email columns by title, each as the bare address, such as emails.Email = ada@example.com, ready for a Send email step's To field, so no step has to pick the address out of the column's text. An email column left blank reads as empty text ("").
output.item: The item as it is now: id, name, state, group, and columns (its columns as text, by title). Beta: also url (the link that opens it in Monday.com), people (the email addresses of the people in each people column, by the column's title) and owner_emails and owner_names (the emails and names in its first people column).
output.previous_value: What the column held before, as text.
output.value: The column's value now, as text: a status's label (such as Done), a person's name, a date. An email column reads as the text Monday.com shows for it, which can be a label someone gave the address rather than the address: use emails for the address itself.

parameters.description: The board to watch for changes.
parameters.name: board_id

parameters.description: Only changes to this column, such as Status. Leave blank for a change to any column.
parameters.name: column_id

parameters.description: Beta. Only run when the column's new value is this, such as Done, so the workflow needs no If step checking the value. Capitals and spaces around it don't matter. Leave blank to run for every change.
parameters.name: changed_to

monday_new_item_trigger.description: Runs for each new item on a Monday.com board. Items already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it.

output.board_id: The board the item is on.
output.columns: The item's columns as text, by the column's title on the board, such as Status, Owner or Due date.
output.group: The title of the group the item was added to.
output.name: The item's name.
output.url: Beta. The link that opens the item in Monday.com.

parameters.description: The board to watch for new items.
parameters.name: board_id

monday_new_update_trigger.description: Runs for each new update (a comment in an item's updates feed) posted on a Monday.com board's items. Updates already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it.

output.author_email: The email of who posted it.
output.board_id: The board the item is on.
output.item_id: The ID of the item it was posted on.
output.item_name: The name of the item it was posted on.
output.text: What the update says, as plain text.

parameters.description: The board to watch for new updates.
parameters.name: board_id
